main_text.l: Credimus veram hanc Ecclesiam debere regi ac gubernari spirituali illa politia, 1. quam nos Deus ipso verbo suo edocuit: nimirum ut sint in ea Pastores ac Ministri, qui purè & concionentur & Sacramenta administrent 2. Sint quoque Seniores & Diaconi, qui Presbyterium, seu Ecclesiæ Senatum constituant 3. ut his veluti medijs vera Religio conservari, veraque doctrina passim propagari & retineri possit: hominesque vitijs dediti spiritualiter corripi & emendari, ac veluti fræno quodam Disciplinæ cohiberi: pauperes item & afflicti auxilio & consolatione pro cujusque necessitate sublevari possint. Tunc enim omnia rite & ordine fient in Ecclesiâ, cum viri fideles ac pij ad ejus gubernationem deligentur, juxta D. Pauli præscriptum, quod habetur.1.Tim.3·& Tit.1.

page.notes: The superscript numbers 1, 2 and 3 in the text (after "politia,", "administrent" and "constituant") are printed reference numbers with no matching note on this page; they are transcribed as printed. The dot after "3" in "Tim.3·" is a printed middle dot. The faint show-through below the rule and at the lower left (e.g. "Iu. Eccl.") is not printed text for this page and is left out. Initial "C" is a drop cap, joined to "Redimus" as "Credimus". Long s is written as a plain s throughout.
